title_en: CALM Before the STORM: Unlocking Native Reasoning for Optimization Modeling
title_zh: 风暴前的 CALM：释放优化建模的原生推理能力

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) create new opportunities for automating optimization modeling, but they also make post-training more delicate.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）为优化建模的自动化创造了新的机遇，但同时也使后训练变得更加微妙。

sentences.en: In this task, strong performance often requires the model to formulate the problem, write solver code, run it, inspect the output, and revise when needed.
sentences.zh: 在这一任务中，出色的性能往往要求模型先形式化问题、编写求解器代码、运行它、检查输出，并在必要时进行修改。

sentences.en: We show that directly fine-tuning LRMs on already written-out Operations Research (OR) solutions can improve easier cases while hurting harder ones, suggesting that this training signal can interfere with the model's own way of solving the task.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，直接在这类已经写好的运筹学（OR）解上微调 LRM，可以改善较容易的情况，却会损害较难的情况，这表明这种训练信号可能会干扰模型自身解决任务的方式。

sentences.en: We therefore propose **CALM** (*Corrective Adaptation with Lightweight Modification*), which lets the base LRM attempt the problem first, then inserts a short hint at the first detected mistake and lets the model continue from there.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 **CALM**（*校正性自适应与轻量修改*，Corrective Adaptation with Lightweight Modification），它先让基础 LRM 尝试解题，在检测到第一个错误时插入一条简短提示，然后让模型从该处继续。

sentences.en: These hints modify fewer than 2.6\% of generated tokens.
sentences.zh: 这些提示修改的 token 不足生成 token 总数的 2.6\%。

sentences.en: The corrected solutions are used for supervised fine-tuning and then reinforcement learning, producing **STORM**, a 4B optimization-modeling specialist that reaches 68.9\% macro-average accuracy across five benchmarks and matches 671B DeepSeek-R1-0528.
sentences.zh: 校正后的解被用于监督微调，随后再用于强化学习，最终得到 **STORM**——一个在五个基准上达到 68.9\% 宏平均准确率、并与 671B 的 DeepSeek-R1-0528 相当的 4B 优化建模专家。

sentences.en: Under a matched hard-benchmark control, CALM also yields stronger final RL performance than direct distillation baselines that train on complete teacher-generated solutions from much stronger models.
sentences.zh: 在匹配的难基准对照下，CALM 也取得了比直接蒸馏基线更强的最终 RL 性能，后者是在强得多的模型所生成的完整教师解上进行训练的。

sentences.en: Overall, for this task, local repair of the base model's own solution is more effective than full teacher-solution replacement.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，对于这一任务，对基础模型自身解进行局部修复，比完全用教师解替代更有效。

sentences.en: Code and models are available at \url{https://github.com/tangzhy/STORM}.
sentences.zh: 代码与模型可在 \url{https://github.com/tangzhy/STORM} 获取。

title_en: CalM: A Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Population Dynamics in Calcium Imaging Data
title_zh: CalM：用于钙成像数据群体动态的自监督基础模型

sentences.en: Recent work suggests that large-scale, multi-animal modeling can significantly improve neural recording analysis.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，大规模、多动物建模能够显著改进神经记录分析。

sentences.en: However, for functional calcium traces, existing approaches remain task-specific, limiting transfer across common neuroscience objectives.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于功能性钙信号轨迹，现有方法仍然是任务特异的，限制了在常见神经科学目标之间的迁移。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{CalM}, a self-supervised neural foundation model trained solely on neuronal calcium traces and adaptable to multiple downstream tasks, including forecasting and decoding.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 \textbf{CalM}——一个仅基于神经元钙信号轨迹训练、并可适配多种下游任务（包括预测与解码）的自监督神经基础模型。

sentences.en: Our key contribution is a pretraining framework, composed of a high-performance tokenizer mapping single-neuron traces into a shared discrete vocabulary, and a dual-axis autoregressive transformer modeling dependencies along both the neural and the temporal axis.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键贡献是一个预训练框架，由两个部分组成：一个将单神经元轨迹映射到共享离散词表的高性能分词器，以及一个沿神经轴与时间轴两个维度建模依赖关系的双轴自回归 transformer。

sentences.en: We evaluate CalM on a large-scale, multi-animal, multi-session dataset.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个大规模、多动物、多会话数据集上评估了 CalM。

sentences.en: On the neural population dynamics forecasting task, CalM outperforms strong specialized baselines after pretraining.
sentences.zh: 在神经群体动力学预测任务上，CalM 在预训练后优于强大的专门化基线。

sentences.en: With a task-specific head, CalM further adapts to the behavior decoding task and achieves superior results compared with supervised decoding models.
sentences.zh: 借助任务特定的头部，CalM 进一步适配到行为解码任务，并取得了优于监督式解码模型的结果。

sentences.en: Moreover, linear analyses of CalM representations reveal interpretable functional structures beyond predictive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 此外，对 CalM 表示进行的线性分析揭示了超越预测准确率的可解释功能结构。

sentences.en: Taken together, we propose a novel and effective self-supervised pretraining paradigm for foundation models based on calcium traces, paving the way for scalable pretraining and broad applications in functional neural analysis.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们提出了一种基于钙信号轨迹的、新颖而有效的自监督预训练范式，为功能神经分析中的可扩展预训练和广泛应用铺平了道路。

title_en: CalPro: Prior-Aware Evidential Conformal Prediction with Structure-Aware Sensitivity Bounds for Protein Structures
title_zh: CalPro：结合结构感知敏感度界、面向蛋白质结构的先验感知证据共形预测

sentences.en: Deep protein structure predictors such as AlphaFold provide confidence estimates (e.g., pLDDT) that are not calibrated and degrade under distribution shifts across experimental modalities, temporal changes, and disordered regions.
sentences.zh: 诸如 AlphaFold 之类的深度蛋白质结构预测器提供的置信度估计（例如 pLDDT）未经校准，并且在跨实验模态、时间变化以及无序区域的分布偏移情况下会退化。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{CalPro}, a prior-aware evidential conformal framework for shift-robust uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 \textbf{CalPro}——一个用于偏移鲁棒不确定性量化的先验感知逼近共形框架。

sentences.en: CalPro combines three components: (i) a geometric evidential head outputting Normal Inverse Gamma distributions via graph neural networks; (ii) a differentiable calibration surrogate that shapes representations during training, followed by split-conformal calibration for finite-sample coverage; and (iii) domain priors (disorder, flexibility) encoded as soft constraints on predicted uncertainty.
sentences.zh: CalPro 结合了三个组件：（i）一个几何逼近头部，通过图神经网络输出正态-逆伽马（Normal Inverse Gamma）分布；（ii）一个可微分的校准代理，在训练期间塑形表示，随后进行分割共形校准以获得有限样本覆盖；（iii）将域先验（无序性、柔韧性）编码为对预测不确定性的软约束。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we derive structure-aware \emph{sensitivity bounds} for coverage degradation under distribution shift using PAC-Bayesian control over ambiguity sets, quantifying how miscoverage increases with model complexity and shift magnitude.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们通过模糊集上的 PAC-Bayesian 控制推导出分布偏移下覆盖退化的结构感知\emph{灵敏度界}，量化误覆盖如何随模型复杂度与偏移幅度而增加。

sentences.en: Empirically, CalPro achieves at most 5 percentage points coverage degradation across modalities compared to 15 to 25 points for baselines, reduces calibration error by 30\% to 50\%, and improves downstream docking success from 52\% to 75\% when filtering by uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，CalPro 在跨模态时的覆盖退化至多为 5 个百分点，而基线为 15 到 25 个百分点；它还将校准误差降低了 30\% 到 50\%，并在按不确定性过滤时，将下游对接成功率从 52\% 提升到 75\%。

sentences.en: The framework extends beyond proteins to structured regression tasks where priors encode local reliability.
sentences.zh: 该框架可推广到蛋白质以外的结构化回归任务，在这些任务中，先验编码了局部可靠性。

title_en: CAMEL: Confidence-Gated Reflection for Reward Modeling
title_zh: CAMEL：奖励建模中的置信度门控反思

sentences.en: Reward models play a fundamental role in aligning large language models with human preferences.
sentences.zh: 奖励模型在使大语言模型与人类偏好对齐方面发挥着根本作用。

sentences.en: Existing methods predominantly follow two paradigms: scalar discriminative preference models, which are efficient but lack interpretability, and generative judging models, which offer richer reasoning at the cost of higher computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要遵循两种范式：标量判别式偏好模型（高效但缺乏可解释性）与生成式评判模型（推理更丰富，但计算开销更高）。

sentences.en: We observe that the log-probability margin between verdict tokens strongly correlates with prediction correctness, providing a reliable proxy for instance difficulty without additional inference cost.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，评判 token 之间的对数概率差与预测正确性强烈相关，为实例难度提供了一个无需额外推理成本的可靠代理。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose CAMEL, a confidence-gated reflection framework that performs a lightweight single-token preference decision first and selectively invokes reflection only for low-confidence instances.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了 CAMEL——一个置信门控反思框架，它先执行一次轻量的单 token 偏好判定，并只对低置信度实例选择性地调用反思。

sentences.en: To induce effective self-correction, we train the model via reinforcement learning with counterfactual prefix augmentation, which exposes the model to diverse initial verdicts and encourages genuine revision.
sentences.zh: 为引出有效的自我修正，我们通过带反事实前缀增强的强化学习来训练模型，使模型接触到多样化的初始判定，并鼓励进行真正的修订。

sentences.en: Empirically, CAMEL achieves state-of-the-art performance on three widely used reward-model benchmarks with 82.9% average accuracy, surpassing the best prior model by 3.2% and outperforming 70B-parameter models using only 14B parameters, while establishing a strictly better accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，CAMEL 在三个广泛使用的奖励模型基准上以 82.9% 的平均准确率达到最先进性能，超越最强先前模型 3.2%，并仅用 14B 参数就胜过 70B 参数模型，同时确立了严格更优的准确率-效率 Pareto 前沿。

title_en: CameraNoise: Enabling Faithful Camera Control in Video Diffusion through Geometry-Flow-Guided Noise Warping
title_zh: CameraNoise：通过几何流引导的噪声变形实现视频扩散中的忠实相机控制

sentences.en: Precise camera pose control is critical for video diffusion, yet maintaining geometric consistency remains a challenge.
sentences.zh: 精确的相机姿态控制对视频扩散至关重要，但保持几何一致性仍然是一大挑战。

sentences.en: Existing methods that directly inject numerical camera parameters into the diffusion backbone often fail to bridge the gap between abstract coordinates and visual content, leading to structural distortions.
sentences.zh: 现有方法将数值相机参数直接注入扩散骨干，往往无法弥合抽象坐标与视觉内容之间的鸿沟，导致结构畸变。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose CameraNoise, a flow-to-noise warping method that encodes camera motion into a temporally coherent stochastic representation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 CameraNoise——一种流到噪声的扭曲方法，将相机运动编码为一个时间上连贯的随机表示。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional conditioning, CameraNoise embeds camera poses directly into the noise space.
sentences.zh: 与常规条件注入不同，CameraNoise 将相机姿态直接嵌入噪声空间。

sentences.en: This decouples motion from scene appearance while faithfully preserving trajectory dynamics.
sentences.zh: 这使运动与场景外观解耦，同时忠实地保留了轨迹动力学。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce a novel Geometry-guided Reprojection Flow and a noise warping algorithm, which jointly preserve the Gaussian prior of diffusion and ensure consistent noise propagation under camera transformations.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入了一种新颖的几何引导重投影流和一种噪声扭曲算法，二者共同保持扩散的高斯先验，并确保相机变换下噪声传播的一致性。

sentences.en: By integrating CameraNoise into the diffusion process, our framework delivers stable, high-fidelity videos.
sentences.zh: 通过将 CameraNoise 集成进扩散过程，我们的框架能够生成稳定、高保真的视频。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms prior methods in both visual quality and trajectory faithfulness.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在视觉质量与轨迹忠实度两方面都显著优于先前方法。

title_en: CamGeo: Sparse Camera-Conditioned Image-to-Video Generation with 3D Geometry Priors
title_zh: CamGeo：融合三维几何先验的稀疏相机条件图生视频

sentences.en: Sparse camera-conditioned image-to-video generation presents a pivotal challenge: synthesizing geometrically consistent 3D motion from minimal pose cues.
sentences.zh: 稀疏相机条件下的图像到视频生成构成一个关键挑战：从极少的姿态线索合成几何一致的 3D 运动。

sentences.en: Existing methods, which largely rely on dense supervision or naive interpolation, suffer from severe pose drift and motion discontinuities due to the lack of robust 3D priors.
sentences.zh: 现有方法大多依赖稠密监督或朴素的插值，由于缺乏稳健的 3D 先验，常常遭受严重的姿态漂移与运动不连续。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce \textbf{CamGeo}, a novel framework that distills rich 3D geometric knowledge from a pre-trained video-to-3D model (VGGT) directly into the diffusion backbone.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了 \textbf{CamGeo}——一个新颖的框架，它将预训练视频到 3D 模型（VGGT）中丰富的 3D 几何知识直接蒸馏进扩散骨干。

sentences.en: To achieve this without incurring inference latency, we propose a training-only distillation strategy.
sentences.zh: 为在不引入推理延迟的情况下实现这一点，我们提出了一种仅训练阶段的蒸馏策略。

sentences.en: Specifically, CamGeo incorporates: (1) keyframe trajectory distillation that enforces cycle-consistency with sparse input poses, (2) cross-frame consistency distillation with both camera trajectory and depth constraints to generate consistent structure across unsupervised frames, and (3) a three-stage coarse-to-fine curriculum learning, progressively scales geometric complexity, from global structure coherence to fine-grained refinement, achieving stable optimization.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CamGeo 包含：（1）关键帧轨迹蒸馏，与稀疏输入姿态强制循环一致性；（2）跨帧一致性蒸馏，结合相机轨迹与深度约束，在无监督帧之间生成一致的结构；（3）三阶段由粗到细的课程学习，逐步提升几何复杂度，从全局结构一致性到细粒度精化，实现稳定的优化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamGeo achieves consistent improvements under various sparsity ratios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CamGeo 在各种稀疏度比例下都取得了持续的改进。

title_en: CAMP: Coherent Alignment of Multimodal Prototypes for Explainable Complementary Learning
title_zh: CAMP：通过多模态原型一致对齐实现可解释互补学习

sentences.en: Most multimodal learning assumes redundant views (such as image–caption pairs), yet many applications require combining complementary modalities that provide distinct evidence (such as an X-ray and medical history).
sentences.zh: 大多数多模态学习假设存在冗余视角（如图像-字幕对），然而许多应用需要组合提供不同证据的互补模态（如 X 光片与病史）。

sentences.en: We term this setting *Complementary Multimodal Classification* (CMC).
sentences.zh: 我们将这种设定称为*互补多模态分类*（CMC，Complementary Multimodal Classification）。

sentences.en: In CMC, existing explainable-by-design methods often force an accuracy–interpretability trade-off because single shared similarity metrics fail under asymmetric, class-conditional evidence.
sentences.zh: 在 CMC 中，现有可解释性内建的方法常常被迫在准确率与可解释性之间取舍，因为单一共享的相似度度量在不对称、类条件证据下会失效。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Coherent Alignment of Multimodal Prototypes (CAMP).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了多模态原型连贯对齐（CAMP）。

sentences.en: CAMP enforces coherent multimodal reasoning by aligning class-wise evidence via optimal transport and imposing geometric constraints to counter modality dominance and representation collapse.
sentences.zh: CAMP 通过最优传输对齐类别级证据，并施加几何约束以对抗模态主导与表示坍缩，从而强制实现连贯的多模态推理。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees showing that these mechanisms eliminate such degeneracies without restricting expressivity.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论保证，表明这些机制能在不限制表达力的前提下消除此类退化。

sentences.en: Empirically, across 16 public CMC datasets, CAMP matches or exceeds large ($>$100M parameter) AutoML baselines with fewer than 1M trainable parameters, and when fine-tuned end-to-end it achieves state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，跨越 16 个公开 CMC 数据集，CAMP 以不足 1M 的可训练参数匹配或超越大型（>100M 参数）AutoML 基线；当端到端微调时，则达到最先进性能。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first modality-agnostic prototype-learning framework designed for complementary multimodal tasks.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是第一个专为互补多模态任务设计的模态无关原型学习框架。

title_en: Can Adaptive Gradient Methods Converge under Heavy-Tailed Noise? A Case Study of AdaGrad
title_zh: 自适应梯度方法能否在重尾噪声下收敛？以 AdaGrad 为例

sentences.en: Many tasks in modern machine learning are observed to involve heavy-tailed gradient noise during the optimization process.
sentences.zh: 现代机器学习中的许多任务在优化过程中都被观察到涉及重尾梯度噪声。

sentences.en: To manage this realistic and challenging setting, new mechanisms, such as gradient clipping and gradient normalization, have been introduced to ensure the convergence of first-order algorithms.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一现实且具有挑战性的设定，人们引入了梯度裁剪和梯度归一化等新机制，以确保一阶算法的收敛。

sentences.en: However, adaptive gradient methods, a famous class of modern optimizers that includes popular $\mathtt{Adam}$ and $\mathtt{AdamW}$, often perform well even without any extra operations mentioned above.
sentences.zh: 然而，自适应梯度方法——包括广受欢迎的 $\mathtt{Adam}$ 和 $\mathtt{AdamW}$ 在内的著名现代优化器类别——即使不使用上述任何额外操作，也往往表现良好。

sentences.en: It is therefore natural to ask whether adaptive gradient methods can converge under heavy-tailed noise without any algorithmic changes.
sentences.zh: 因此，自然要问：自适应梯度方法能否在无需任何算法改动的情况下，于重尾噪声下收敛？

sentences.en: In this work, we take the first step toward answering this question by investigating a special case, $\mathtt{AdaGrad}$, the origin of adaptive gradient methods.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过考察一个特殊情形——$\mathtt{AdaGrad}$，即自适应梯度方法的起源——迈出了回答这个问题的第一步。

sentences.en: We provide the first provable convergence rate for $\mathtt{AdaGrad}$ in non-convex optimization when the tail index $p$ satisfies $4/3<p\leq2$.
sentences.zh: 我们首次给出了当尾部指数 p 满足 $4/3<p\leq 2$ 时，$\mathtt{AdaGrad}$ 在非凸优化中的可证明收敛速率。

sentences.en: Notably, this result is achieved without requiring any prior knowledge of $p$ and is hence adaptive to the tail index.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这一结果无需任何关于 p 的先验知识，因而对尾部指数具有自适应性。

sentences.en: In addition, we develop an algorithm-dependent lower bound, suggesting that the existing minimax rate for heavy-tailed optimization is not attainable by $\mathtt{AdaGrad}$.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们推导了一个与算法相关的下界，表明现有针对重尾优化的极小极大速率并非 $\mathtt{AdaGrad}$ 所能达到。

sentences.en: Lastly, we consider $\mathtt{AdaGrad}\text{-}\mathtt{Norm}$, a popular variant of $\mathtt{AdaGrad}$ in theoretical studies, and show an improved rate that holds for any $1<p\leq2$ under an extra mild assumption.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们考虑了 $\mathtt{AdaGrad}\text{-}\mathtt{Norm}$——$\mathtt{AdaGrad}$ 在理论研究中一个流行的变体，并证明在一个额外温和假设下，对于任意 $1<p\leq 2$ 都存在改进的速率。

title_en: Can Agents Generalize to the Open World? Unveiling the Fragility of Static Training in Tool Use
title_zh: 智能体能否泛化到开放世界？揭示工具使用中静态训练的脆弱性

sentences.en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate proficiency in static benchmarks, their deployment in real-world scenarios is hindered by the dynamic nature of user queries, tool sets, and interaction dynamics.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）代理在静态基准上表现出熟练度，但它们在真实场景中的部署受到用户查询、工具集和交互动态多变性的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address this generalization gap, we formalize **OpenAgent** (Tool-Use Agent in Open-World), a problem setting characterized by distributional shifts across query, action, observation, and domain dimensions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一泛化差距，我们形式化了 **OpenAgent**（开放世界中的工具使用代理）——一个以查询、动作、观察和域维度上分布偏移为特征的问题设定。

sentences.en: To systematically diagnose its impact, we construct a controlled sandbox environment where we define fine-grained environmental shifts across a four-tier hierarchy, *Perception*, *Interaction*, *Reasoning*, and *Internalization*, and conduct a comprehensive series of experiments.
sentences.zh: 为系统性地诊断其影响，我们构建了一个受控的沙盒环境，在其中跨四级层级——*感知（Perception）*、*交互（Interaction）*、*推理（Reasoning）*与*内化（Internalization）*——定义了细粒度的环境偏移，并开展了一系列全面的实验。

sentences.en: Our analysis yields a series of key insights, demonstrating that agents trained via both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning suffer from varying degrees of performance degradation when confronting open environmental shifts.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析得出一系列关键洞见，表明通过监督微调（SFT）与强化学习训练的代理，在直面开放环境偏移时都会遭受不同程度的性能退化。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we propose Perturbation-Augmented Fine-Tuning, a disturbance-based intervention strategy for SFT that lays the foundation for enhancing agent robustness and utility in realistic environments.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们提出了扰动增强微调（Perturbation-Augmented Fine-Tuning）——一种针对 SFT 的基于干扰的干预策略，为在真实环境中增强代理鲁棒性与实用性奠定基础。

sentences.en: Our code will be released at: [https://github.com/LAMDA-NeSy/OpenAgent](https://github.com/LAMDA-NeSy/OpenAgent).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将在 https://github.com/LAMDA-NeSy/OpenAgent 发布。

title_en: Can Computational Reducibility Lead to Transferable Models for Graph Combinatorial Optimization?
title_zh: 计算可归约性能否带来可迁移的图组合优化模型？

sentences.en: A key challenge in deriving unified neural solvers for combinatorial optimization (CO) is efficient generalization of models between one set of tasks to new tasks not used during the initial training process.
sentences.zh: 为组合优化（CO）构建统一神经求解器的一个关键挑战，是在一组任务与初始训练过程中未出现的新任务之间实现模型的高效泛化。

sentences.en: To address it, we first establish a new GNN encoder, which uses a GCON module as a form of expressive message passing together with energy-based unsupervised loss functions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们首先构建了一个新的 GNN 编码器，它采用 GCON 模块作为富有表现力的消息传递形式，并结合基于能量的无监督损失函数。

sentences.en: This model achieves high performance (often comparable with state-of-the-art results) across multiple CO tasks when trained individually on each task.
sentences.zh: 该模型在多个 CO 任务上，当逐任务单独训练时，都取得了高性能（通常可与最先进结果相媲美）。

sentences.en: We then leverage knowledge from the computational reducibility literature to propose pretraining and fine-tuning strategies to transfer effectively (a) between MVC, MIS and MaxClique, and (b) in a multi-task learning setting that additionally incorporates MaxCut, MDS and graph coloring.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们借鉴计算可归约性文献的知识，提出了预训练与微调策略，以在（a）MVC、MIS 与 MaxClique 之间，以及（b）另外纳入 MaxCut、MDS 与图着色的多任务学习设定中进行有效迁移。

sentences.en: Additionally, in a leave-one-out, multi-task learning setting, we observe that pretraining on all but one task almost always leads to faster convergence on the remaining task when fine-tuning while avoiding negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 此外，在留一法的多任务学习设定中，我们观察到，在除一个任务外的其余任务上进行预训练，几乎总能加快对该剩余任务的微调收敛，同时避免负迁移。

sentences.en: Our findings indicate that learning common representations across multiple graph CO problems is viable through the use of expressive message passing coupled with pretraining strategies that are informed by the polynomial reduction literature, thereby taking an important step towards enabling the development of foundational models for neural CO.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，借助富有表现力的消息传递、并结合多项式归约文献所启发的预训练策略，跨多个图 CO 问题学习共同表示是可行的，从而向开发面向神经 CO 的基础模型迈出了重要一步。

authors.name: Semih Cantürk
authors.institution: Mila - Quebec AI Institute, Université de Montréal

title_en: Can I Have Your Order? Monte-Carlo Tree Search for Slot Filling Ordering in Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 可以告诉我顺序吗？利用蒙特卡洛树搜索确定扩散语言模型的槽位填充顺序

sentences.en: While plan-and-infill decoding in Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) shows promise for mathematical and code reasoning, performance remains highly sensitive to slot infilling order, often yielding substantial output variance.
sentences.zh: 虽然掩码扩散模型（MDM）中的规划-填空（plan-and-infill）解码在数学与代码推理方面展现出前景，但其性能对插槽填充顺序高度敏感，往往产生明显的输出方差。

sentences.en: We introduce DiffuSearch, a framework that formulates slot selection as decision making and optimises infilling orders through Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS).
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 DiffuSearch——一个将插槽选择形式化为决策问题、并通过蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）优化填充顺序的框架。

sentences.en: DiffuSearch uses look-ahead simulations to evaluate partial completions before commitment, systematically exploring the combinatorial space of generation orders.
sentences.zh: DiffuSearch 使用前瞻模拟，在做出承诺之前评估部分完成结果，系统地探索生成顺序的组合空间。

sentences.en: Experiments show an average improvement of 3.2% over autoregressive baselines and 8.0% over baseline plan-and-infill, with notable gains of 19.5% on MBPP and 4.9% on MATH500.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，较自回归基线平均改进 3.2%，较基线规划-填空改进 8.0%，其中在 MBPP 上提升显著达 19.5%，在 MATH500 上达 4.9%。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that while DiffuSearch predominantly follows sequential ordering, incorporating non-sequential generation is essential for maximising performance.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，虽然 DiffuSearch 主要遵循顺序式生成，但纳入非顺序式生成对于最大化性能至关重要。

sentences.en: We observe that larger exploration constants, rather than increased simulations, are necessary to overcome model confidence biases and discover effective orderings.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，需要更大的探索常数而非更多模拟次数，才能克服模型置信度偏差并发现有效的生成顺序。

sentences.en: These findings establish MCTS-based planning as an effective approach for enhancing generation quality in MDMs.
sentences.zh: 这些发现确立了基于 MCTS 的规划作为增强 MDM 生成质量的有效途径。

authors.institution: Imperial College London, University of Oxford

title_en: Can Large Language Models Generalize Procedures Across Representations?
title_zh: 大语言模型能否跨表征泛化操作过程？

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained and tested extensively on symbolic representations such as code and graphs, yet real-world user tasks are often specified in natural language.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在代码和图等符号表示上进行了广泛的训练与测试，然而真实世界的用户任务往往以自然语言描述。

sentences.en: To what extent can LLMs generalize across these representations?
sentences.zh: LLM 能在多大程度上跨这些表示进行泛化？

sentences.en: Here, we approach this question by studying isomorphic tasks involving procedures represented in code, graphs, and natural language (e.g., scheduling steps in planning).
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们通过研究以代码、图和自然语言表示的等构程序任务（例如规划中的调度步骤）来探讨这一问题。

sentences.en: We find that training LLMs with popular post-training methods on graphs or code data alone does not reliably generalize to corresponding natural language tasks, while training solely on natural language can lead to inefficient performance gains.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，单独在图表或代码数据上使用流行的后训练方法训练 LLM，并不能可靠地泛化到相应的自然语言任务；而仅以自然语言训练则会导致低效的性能提升。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum that first trains on symbolic, then natural language data.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种两阶段强化学习课程，先训练符号数据，再训练自然语言数据。

sentences.en: The curriculum substantially improves model performance across model families and tasks.
sentences.zh: 该课程在多个模型家族与任务上大幅提升了模型性能。

sentences.en: Remarkably, a 1.5B Qwen model trained by our method can closely match zero-shot GPT-4o in naturalistic planning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，由我们的方法训练的 1.5B Qwen 模型，在自然式规划上能与零样本 GPT-4o 相近。

sentences.en: Finally, our analysis suggests that successful cross-representation generalization can be interpreted as a form of generative analogy, which our curriculum effectively encourages.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的分析表明，成功的跨表示泛化可以解释为一种生成式类比，而我们的课程有效地鼓励了这一点。

sentences.en: The dataset and code used in this paper can be found \href{https://github.com/fangru-lin/procedure_generalization_llm}{here}.
sentences.zh: 本文使用的数据集与代码可在 \href{https://github.com/fangru-lin/procedure_generalization_llm}{此处} 找到。

title_en: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script?  Modeling Commitment in Interactive Narratives
title_zh: 大语言模型智能体能否遵循剧本？对交互叙事中的承诺进行建模

sentences.en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速进步正通过支持开放式、流畅的交互式叙事来变革 AI for Games。

sentences.en: However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有研究在很大程度上忽视了在不受约束的用户干预下保持逻辑一致性与叙事完整性的关键挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we formulate this challenge as *Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP)*, and take interactive narrative as our testbed.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们将这一挑战形式化为*叙事承诺保持*（NCP，Narrative Commitment Preservation），并以交互式叙事作为测试平台。

sentences.en: We introduce **NCP-Bench**, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 **NCP-Bench**——一个由 100 个源自电影梗概的叙事环境组成的基准。

sentences.en: Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent.
sentences.zh: 每个环境都包含一份结构化叙事规范（轨迹、承诺与初始事实），我们可以在玩家代理与叙述者代理的整个交互过程中自动对其核查。

sentences.en: Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 40\% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40\% to 68\% across models.
sentences.zh: 跨最先进 LLM 的实验表明，高语言质量并不能保证承诺保持；即使强大的模型也常常在对抗性干预下生成逻辑冲突的内容，表现最佳的模型（GPT-5.2）在 20 轮之后也仅有 40\% 的生存率，且各模型的事实冲突率介于 40\% 到 68\% 之间。

title_en: Can LLMs Reason Like Automated Theorem Provers for Rust Verification? VCoT-Bench: Evaluating via Verification Chain of Thought
title_zh: 大语言模型能否像自动定理证明器一样推理以验证 Rust？VCoT-Bench：通过验证思维链进行评估

sentences.en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly assist secure software development, their ability to meet the rigorous demands of Rust program verification remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地助力安全软件开发，它们能否满足 Rust 程序验证的严格需求仍不明确。

sentences.en: Existing evaluations treat Rust verification as a black box, assessing models only by binary pass or fail outcomes for proof hints.
sentences.zh: 现有评估将 Rust 验证视为黑盒，仅根据证明提示的二元通过/失败结果来评判模型。

sentences.en: This obscures whether models can systematically reconstruct the explicit deductive steps required for verifying nontrivial Rust code.
sentences.zh: 这掩盖了模型是否能够系统地重建验证非平凡 Rust 代码所需的显式演绎步骤。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce VCoT-Lift, a framework that lifts low-level solver reasoning into high-level, human-readable verification steps.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了 VCoT-Lift——一个将低层求解器推理提升为高层、人类可读验证步骤的框架。

sentences.en: By exposing solver-level reasoning as an explicit Verification Chain-of-Thought, VCoT-Lift provides a concrete ground truth for fine-grained evaluation.
sentences.zh: 通过将求解器层面的推理暴露为显式的验证思维链（Verification Chain-of-Thought），VCoT-Lift 为细粒度评估提供了具体的真实标准。

sentences.en: Leveraging VCoT-Lift, we introduce VCoT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,988 VCoT completion tasks for rigorously evaluating LLMs' ability to reconstruct the entire verification process.
sentences.zh: 借助 VCoT-Lift，我们引入了 VCoT-Bench——一个包含 1,988 个 VCoT 补全任务的全面基准，用于严格评估 LLM 重建整个验证过程的能力。

sentences.en: VCoT-Bench measures performance along three orthogonal dimensions: robustness to varying degrees of missing proofs, competence across different proof types, and sensitivity to proof locations.
sentences.zh: VCoT-Bench 沿三个正交维度度量性能：对不同程度缺失证明的鲁棒性、跨不同类型证明的能力，以及对证明位置的敏感性。

sentences.en: Evaluation of ten state-of-the-art models reveals severe fragility, indicating that current LLMs fall well short of the reasoning capabilities exhibited by automated theorem provers.
sentences.zh: 对十个最先进模型的评估揭示了严重的脆弱性，表明当前 LLM 与自动定理证明器所展现的推理能力相去甚远。

title_en: Can LLMs Reason Structurally? Benchmarking via the lens of Data Structures
title_zh: 大语言模型能否进行结构化推理？从数据结构视角开展评测

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed on increasingly complex tasks that require multi-step decision-making.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被部署在日益复杂、需要多步决策的任务上。

sentences.en: Understanding their algorithmic reasoning abilities is therefore crucial.
sentences.zh: 因此，理解它们的算法推理能力至关重要。

sentences.en: However, we lack a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating these capabilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们缺乏一个用于评估这些能力的诊断性基准。

sentences.en: We propose to use data structures as a principled lens: as fundamental building blocks of algorithms, they naturally probe structural reasoning—the ability to understand and manipulate relationships such as order, hierarchy, and connectivity that underpin algorithmic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们提议将数据结构作为一把原则化的镜子：作为算法的基础构件，它们天然地能探测结构性推理——即理解并操作支撑算法推理的排序、层级与连通性等关系的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce DSR-Bench (Data Structure Reasoning Benchmark), spanning 20 data structures, 35 operations, and 4,140 problem instances.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 DSR-Bench（数据结构推理基准），覆盖 20 种数据结构、35 种操作与 4,140 个问题实例。

sentences.en: DSR-Bench features hierarchical task organization, fully automated generation and evaluation, and fine-grained diagnostics.
sentences.zh: DSR-Bench 具有层级化任务组织、全自动化生成与评估，以及细粒度诊断的特点。

sentences.en: Evaluating 13 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals critical limitations: the top-performing model achieves only 0.46/1 on challenging instances.
sentences.zh: 对 13 个最先进 LLM 的评估揭示了关键局限：表现最佳的模型在具有挑战性的实例上仅达到 0.46/1。

sentences.en: Three auxiliary probes targeting more realistic usages expose further weaknesses: models perform poorly on spatial data and context-rich scenarios, and they struggle to reason over their own code.
sentences.zh: 三个针对更真实用法的辅助探针进一步暴露出弱点：模型在空间数据与上下文丰富的场景上表现不佳，并且难以对自己编写的代码进行推理。

title_en: Can local learning match self-supervised backpropagation?
title_zh: 局部学习能否媲美自监督反向传播？

sentences.en: While end-to-end self-supervised learning with backpropagation (global BP-SSL) has become central for training modern AI systems, theories of local self-supervised learning (local-SSL) have struggled to build functional representations in deep neural networks.
sentences.zh: 虽然使用反向传播的端到端自监督学习（全局 BP-SSL）已成为训练现代 AI 系统的核心，但局部自监督学习（local-SSL）的理论难以在深度神经网络中构建功能性的表示。

sentences.en: To establish a link between global and local rules, we first develop a theory for deep linear networks: We identify conditions for local-SSL algorithms (like Forward-forward or CLAPP) to implement exactly the same weight update as a global BP-SSL.
sentences.zh: 为建立全局规则与局部规则之间的联系，我们首先为深度线性网络发展了一套理论：我们识别出 local-SSL 算法（如 Forward-forward 或 CLAPP）能够精确实现与全局 BP-SSL 相同权重更新的条件。

sentences.en: Starting from the theoretical insights, we then develop novel variants of local-SSL algorithms to approximate global BP-SSL in deep non-linear convolutional neural networks.
sentences.zh: 从这些理论洞见出发，我们随后开发了 local-SSL 算法的新变体，以在深度非线性卷积神经网络中近似全局 BP-SSL。

sentences.en: Variants that improve the similarity between updates of local-SSL with those of global BP-SSL also show better performance on image datasets (CIFAR-10, STL-10, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet).
sentences.zh: 那些改进 local-SSL 与全局 BP-SSL 更新相似性的变体，在图像数据集（CIFAR-10、STL-10、Tiny ImageNet 和 ImageNet）上也表现出更好的性能。

sentences.en: The best local-SSL rule with the CLAPP loss function matches the performance of a comparable global BP-SSL with InfoNCE or CPC-like loss functions, and improves upon state-of-the-art for layer-wise SSL on these benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 使用 CLAPP 损失函数的最佳 local-SSL 规则，与使用 InfoNCE 或类 CPC 损失函数的可比全局 BP-SSL 性能相当，并改进了这些基准上逐层 SSL 的最先进水平。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Can Microcanonical Langevin Dynamics Leverage Mini-Batch Gradient Noise?
title_zh: 微正则 Langevin 动力学能否利用小批量梯度噪声？

sentences.en: Scaling inference methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo to high-dimensional models remains a central challenge in Bayesian deep learning.
sentences.zh: 将马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）等推断方法扩展到高维模型，仍是贝叶斯深度学习中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: A promising recent proposal, microcanonical Langevin Monte Carlo, has shown state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of problems.
sentences.zh: 一个近来颇具前景的方案——微正则朗之万蒙特卡洛（microcanonical Langevin Monte Carlo）——已在广泛问题上展现出最先进的性能。

sentences.en: However, its reliance on full-dataset gradients makes it prohibitively expensive for large-scale problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，它对全数据集梯度的依赖，使其在大规模问题上代价高昂到难以承受。

sentences.en: This paper addresses a fundamental question: Can microcanonical dynamics effectively leverage mini-batch gradient noise?
sentences.zh: 本文探讨一个根本性问题：微正则动力学能否有效地利用小批量梯度噪声？

sentences.en: We provide the first systematic study of this problem, establishing a novel continuous-time theoretical analysis of stochastic-gradient microcanonical dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了对这一问题的首次系统性研究，建立起随机梯度微正则动力学的一种新颖连续时间理论分析。

sentences.en: We reveal two critical failure modes: a theoretically derived bias due to anisotropic gradient noise and numerical instabilities in complex high-dimensional posteriors.
sentences.zh: 我们揭示了两种关键的失效模式：由各向异性梯度噪声导致的理论推导偏差，以及复杂高维后验中的数值不稳定。

sentences.en: To tackle these issues, we propose a principled gradient noise preconditioning scheme shown to significantly reduce this bias and develop a novel, energy-variance-based adaptive tuner that automates step size selection and dynamically informs numerical guardrails.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种原则化的梯度噪声预条件方案（可显著减小该偏差），并开发了一种基于能量方差的、新颖的自适应调节器，可自动选择步长并动态提供数值防护栏。

sentences.en: The resulting algorithm is a robust and scalable microcanonical Monte Carlo sampler that achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging high-dimensional inference tasks like Bayesian neural networks.
sentences.zh: 由此得到的算法是一个稳健且可扩展的微正则蒙特卡洛采样器，在贝叶斯神经网络等具有挑战性的高维推断任务上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Combined with recent ensemble techniques, our work unlocks a new class of stochastic microcanonical Langevin ensemble (SMILE) samplers for large-scale Bayesian inference.
sentences.zh: 结合近期的集成技术，我们的工作为大规模贝叶斯推断解锁了一类新的随机微正则朗之万集成（SMILE）采样器。

title_en: Can Muon Fine-tune Adam-Pretrained Models?
title_zh: Muon 能否微调由 Adam 预训练的模型？

sentences.en: Muon has emerged as an efficient alternative to Adam for pretraining, yet remains underused for fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: Muon 已成为 Adam 在预训练中的一种高效替代方案，但在微调中仍未被充分利用。

sentences.en: A key obstacle is that most open models are pretrained with Adam, and naively switching to Muon for fine-tuning leads to degraded performance due to an optimizer mismatch.
sentences.zh: 一个关键障碍是：大多数开源模型都使用 Adam 预训练，而朴素地切换到 Muon 进行微调会因优化器不匹配而导致性能退化。

sentences.en: We investigate this mismatch through controlled experiments and relate it to the distinct implicit biases of Adam and Muon.
sentences.zh: 我们通过受控实验考察了这一不匹配，并将其归因于 Adam 与 Muon 不同的隐式偏置。

sentences.en: We provide evidence that the mismatch disrupts pretrained knowledge, and that this disruption scales with update strength.
sentences.zh: 我们提供的证据表明，这种不匹配会扰动预训练知识，且这种扰动随更新强度而扩展。

sentences.en: This leads us to hypothesize that constraining updates should mitigate the mismatch.
sentences.zh: 这使我们假设：限制更新幅度应能缓解这种不匹配。

sentences.en: We validate this with LoRA: across language and vision tasks, LoRA reduces the performance gap between Adam and Muon observed under full fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们以 LoRA 验证了这一点：在语言与视觉任务上，LoRA 缩小了完全微调下观察到的 Adam 与 Muon 之间的性能差距。

sentences.en: Studies on LoRA rank, catastrophic forgetting, and LoRA variants further confirm that mismatch severity correlates with update strength.
sentences.zh: 对 LoRA 秩、灾难性遗忘和 LoRA 变体的研究进一步确认，不匹配的严重程度与更新强度相关。

sentences.en: These results shed light on how optimizer mismatch affects fine-tuning and how it can be mitigated.
sentences.zh: 这些结果阐释了优化器不匹配如何影响微调，以及如何缓解它。

sentences.en: Our code is available [here](https://github.com/XingyuQu/muon-finetune).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 [此处](https://github.com/XingyuQu/muon-finetune) 获取。

title_en: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
title_zh: 推荐系统能否自学？具有保真度控制的递归自我改进框架

sentences.en: The scarcity of high-quality training data presents a fundamental bottleneck to scaling machine learning models.
sentences.zh: 高质量训练数据的稀缺是扩展机器学习模型的一个根本瓶颈。

sentences.en: This challenge is particularly acute in recommendation systems, where extreme sparsity in user interactions leads to rugged optimization landscapes and poor generalization.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战在推荐系统中尤为严峻，用户交互的极度稀疏会带来崎岖的优化景观与较差的泛化能力。

sentences.en: We propose the Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation (RSIR) framework, a paradigm in which a model bootstraps its own performance without reliance on external data or teacher models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了递归自改进推荐（RSIR）框架——一种模型在不依赖外部数据或教师模型的情况下自行启动自身性能的范式。

sentences.en: RSIR operates in a closed loop: the current model generates plausible user interaction sequences, a fidelity-based quality control mechanism filters them for consistency with user’s approximate preference manifold, and a successor model is augmented on the enriched dataset.
sentences.zh: RSIR 在一个闭环中运作：当前模型生成合理的用户交互序列，一个基于保真度的质量控制机制依据用户近似的偏好流形对其进行一致性筛选，然后一个后继模型在增强后的数据集上进一步训练。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis shows that RSIR acts as a data-driven implicit regularizer, smoothing the optimization landscape and guiding models toward more robust solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析表明，RSIR 充当一种数据驱动的隐式正则化器，平滑优化景观并引导模型走向更稳健的解。

sentences.en: Empirically, RSIR yields consistent, cumulative gains across multiple benchmarks and architectures.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，RSIR 在多个基准与架构上带来一致、累积的收益。

sentences.en: Notably, even smaller models benefit, and weak models can generate effective training curricula for stronger ones.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，即使是较小的模型也能受益，且弱模型能为强模型生成有效的训练课程。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that recursive self-improvement is a general, model-agnostic approach to overcoming data sparsity, suggesting a scalable path forward for recommender systems and beyond.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，递归自改进是一种通用的、模型无关的克服数据稀疏性的方法，为推荐系统乃至更多领域指明了一条可扩展的前进之路。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/USTC-StarTeam/RSIR.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/USTC-StarTeam/RSIR 获取。

title_en: Can Vision Language Models Learn Intuitive Physics from Interaction?
title_zh: 视觉语言模型能否从交互中学习直觉物理？

sentences.en: Pre-trained vision language models do not have good intuitions about the physical world.
sentences.zh: 预训练的视觉语言模型对物理世界缺乏良好的直觉。

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that supervised fine-tuning can improve model performance on simple physical tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，监督微调能够提升模型在简单物理任务上的性能。

sentences.en: However, fine-tuned models do not appear to learn robust physical rules that can generalize to new contexts.
sentences.zh: 然而，微调后的模型似乎并未学到能够泛化到新情境的稳健物理规则。

sentences.en: Based on research in cognitive science, we hypothesize that models need to interact with an environment to properly learn its physical dynamics.
sentences.zh: 基于认知科学的研究，我们假设模型需要与环境交互，才能恰当地学习其物理动力学。

sentences.en: We train models that learn through interaction with a simulated environment using reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们训练模型通过强化学习与模拟环境交互来学习。

sentences.en: While learning from interaction allows models to improve their within-task performance, it fails to produce models with generalizable physical intuitions.
sentences.zh: 虽然从交互中学习能让模型提升任务内性能，但它无法造就具有可泛化物理直觉的模型。

sentences.en: We find that models trained on one task do not reliably generalize to related tasks, even if the tasks share visual statistics and physical principles, and regardless of whether the models are trained through interaction.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在一个任务上训练的模型无法可靠地泛化到相关任务，即使这些任务共享视觉统计特性和物理原理，也与模型是否通过交互训练无关。

title_en: Can VLMs Diagnose and Recover from VLA Manipulation Faults?
title_zh: 视觉语言模型能否诊断并恢复视觉–语言–动作模型的操作故障？

sentences.en: Existing VLA models frequently fail in robotic manipulation tasks, with poorly structured fault types that often require expert diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 现有 VLA 模型在机器人操作任务中常常失败，其故障类型结构不良，往往需要专家诊断。

sentences.en: While VLMs offer strong explanatory capabilities, their effectiveness in assisting VLAs is limited by their unclear role in diagnostics and inadequate collaboration mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 虽然 VLM 具备强大的解释能力，但它们在协助 VLA 方面的有效性受限于其不明确的诊断角色与不足的协作机制。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce VLA-FixBench, a fault evaluation dataset that spans perception, planning, and control failures, and provides annotations for task stages, fault types, and spatiotemporal repair strategies.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入了 VLA-FixBench——一个覆盖感知、规划与控制失败的故障评估数据集，并提供任务阶段、故障类型以及时空修复策略的标注。

sentences.en: We further propose FaultEval, a static-to-dynamic-to-real evaluation framework that benchmarks 20 VLMs across multiple fault-related dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出了 FaultEval——一个从静态到动态再到真实的评估框架，在多个与故障相关的维度上对 20 个 VLM 进行基准测试。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we design a VLM–VLA collaboration mechanism that localizes spatiotemporal deviations and rolls back task execution to enable targeted recovery.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们设计了一种 VLM–VLA 协作机制，定位时空偏差并回滚任务执行，以实现有目标的恢复。

sentences.en: Experiments show that FaultEval reliably characterizes VLM-based closed-loop diagnosis and repair.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，FaultEval 能够可靠地刻画基于 VLM 的闭环诊断与修复。

sentences.en: The upper-bound analysis using human expert intervention shows that an idealized feedback loop can improve task success rates by 13\% on LIBERO and 35\% on real-world robots.
sentences.zh: 使用人类专家干预的上界分析显示，一个理想化的反馈回路能将 LIBERO 上的任务成功率提高 13\%，在真实机器人上提高 35\%。

sentences.en: Our code, benchmark, and project page will be publicly released at:  https://kakigo.github.io/VLA-FixBench/
sentences.zh: 我们的代码、基准与项目页面将在 https://kakigo.github.io/VLA-FixBench/ 公开发布。

title_en: Can We Build a Monolithic Model for Fake Image Detection? SICA: Semantic-Induced Constrained Adaptation for Unified-Yet-Discriminative Artifact Feature Space Reconstruction
title_zh: 能否构建单体模型检测伪造图像？SICA：通过语义诱导约束适配重建统一且可区分的伪影特征空间

sentences.en: Fake Image Detection (FID), aiming at unified detection across four image forensic subdomains, is critical in real-world forensic scenarios.
sentences.zh: 假图像检测（FID）旨在跨四个图像取证子领域实现统一检测，在真实取证场景中至关重要。

sentences.en: Compared with ensemble approaches, monolithic FID models are theoretically more promising, but to date, consistently yield inferior performance in practice.
sentences.zh: 与集成方法相比，单一式（monolithic）FID 模型在理论上更有前景，但迄今为止在实践中始终表现较差。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify the intrinsic distinctness of artifacts across subdomains—a critical barrier we term the "Ji-Zhe phenomenon".
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别出各子领域之间伪迹的内在差异性——一个我们称之为“Ji-Zhe 现象”的关键障碍。

sentences.en: Driven by this phenomenon, we diagnose the cause of this underperformance for the first time: the collapse of the artifact feature space.
sentences.zh: 受这一现象的驱动，我们首次诊断出这一表现不佳的成因：伪迹特征空间的坍缩。

sentences.en: The core challenge for developing a practical monolithic FID model thus boils down to the "unified-yet-discriminative" reconstruction of the artifact feature space.
sentences.zh: 因此，开发实用单一式 FID 模型的核心挑战可归结为对伪迹特征空间进行“统一而具判别性”的重建。

sentences.en: To address this paradoxical challenge, we hypothesize that high-level semantics can serve as a structural prior for the reconstruction, and further propose Semantic-Induced Constrained Adaptation (SICA), the first monolithic FID paradigm.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一悖论式的挑战，我们假设高层语义可以作为重建的结构先验，并进一步提出了语义诱导约束适配（SICA）——第一个单一式 FID 范式。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on our $ \textit{OpenMMSec} $ dataset demonstrate that SICA outperforms 15 state-of-the-art methods and reconstructs the target unified-yet-discriminative artifact feature space in a near-orthogonal manner, thus firmly validating our hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 在我们 $\textit{OpenMMSec}$ 数据集上进行的大量实验表明，SICA 优于 15 种最先进方法，并以近乎正交的方式重建了目标中的统一而具判别性的伪迹特征空间，从而有力地验证了我们的假设。

sentences.en: The code and dataset will be made publicly available.
sentences.zh: 代码与数据集将公开发布。

title_en: CANDI: Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Diffusion Models
title_zh: CANDI：混合离散–连续扩散模型

sentences.en: While continuous diffusion has shown remarkable success in continuous domains such as image generation, its direct application to discrete data has underperformed pure discrete formulations.
sentences.zh: 虽然连续扩散在图像生成等连续领域取得了显著成功，但其直接应用于离散数据时的表现却不如纯离散形式。

sentences.en: To understand this gap, we introduce *token identifiability*, an analytical framework characterizing how Gaussian noise corrupts discrete data through two mechanisms: *discrete identity corruption* and *continuous rank degradation*.
sentences.zh: 为理解这一差距，我们引入了*token 可辨识性*（token identifiability）——一种刻画高斯噪声如何通过两种机制破坏离散数据的分析框架：*离散身份破坏*（discrete identity corruption）与*连续秩退化*（continuous rank degradation）。

sentences.en: We reveal that these mechanisms scale differently with vocabulary size, creating a *temporal dissonance* that forces a tradeoff between learning continuous geometry and discrete structure.
sentences.zh: 我们揭示，这两种机制随词表大小的扩展方式不同，从而产生一种*temporal 失调*（temporal dissonance），迫使人们在学习连续几何与离散结构之间做出取舍。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **CANDI** (**C**ontinuous **AN**d **DI**screte diffusion), a hybrid framework that decouples discrete and continuous corruption, enabling simultaneous learning of both.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 **CANDI**（**C**ontinuous **AN**d **DI**screte diffusion，连续与离散扩散）——一个解耦离散与连续破坏的混合框架，从而能够同时学习两者。

sentences.en: This unlocks the benefits of continuous diffusion for discrete spaces: on controlled generation, CANDI enables classifier-based guidance with off-the-shelf classifiers through simple gradient addition; on text generation, CANDI outperforms masked diffusion at low NFE, demonstrating the value of learning continuous gradients for discrete spaces.
sentences.zh: 这为离散空间解锁了连续扩散的益处：在受控生成上，CANDI 通过简单的梯度加法，即可利用现成分类器实现基于分类器的引导；在文本生成上，CANDI 在低 NFE 下优于掩码扩散，展现了在离散空间学习连续梯度的价值。

title_en: CAOS: Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors
title_zh: CAOS：单次预测器的共形聚合

sentences.en: One-shot prediction enables rapid adaptation of pretrained foundation models to new tasks using only one labeled example, but lacks principled uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 一次性预测使预训练基础模型仅凭一个标注示例就能快速适应新任务，但缺乏有原则的不确定性量化。

sentences.en: While conformal prediction provides finite-sample coverage guarantees, standard split conformal methods are inefficient in the one-shot setting due to data splitting and reliance on a single predictor.
sentences.zh: 虽然共形预测提供了有限样本的覆盖保证，但标准的切分共形方法在一次性设定下因数据切分和对单一预测器的依赖而效率低下。

sentences.en: We propose Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors (CAOS), a conformal framework that adaptively aggregates multiple one-shot predictors and uses a leave-one-out calibration scheme to fully exploit scarce labeled data.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了共形聚合的一次性预测器（CAOS）——一个自适应地聚合多个一次性预测器、并使用留一法校准方案来充分利用稀缺标注数据的共形框架。

sentences.en: Despite violating classical exchangeability assumptions, we prove that CAOS achieves valid marginal coverage using a monotonicity-based argument.
sentences.zh: 尽管违反了经典的交换性假设，我们仍通过一个基于单调性的论证证明了 CAOS 能实现有效的边际覆盖。

sentences.en: Experiments on one-shot facial landmarking and RAFT text classification tasks show that CAOS produces substantially smaller prediction sets than split conformal baselines while maintaining reliable coverage.
sentences.zh: 在一次性人脸关键点定位和 RAFT 文本分类任务上的实验表明，CAOS 比切分共形基线产生了小得多的预测集，同时保持了可靠的覆盖。

title_en: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
title_zh: CaP-X：评测并改进机器人操作编程智能体的框架

sentences.en: Code-as-Policy (CaP) is a paradigm in which a language or vision-language model generates executable robot control programs, yet its effectiveness as an autonomous controller for embodied manipulation remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 代码即策略（CaP）是一种由语言或视觉-语言模型生成可执行机器人控制程序的范式，但它作为具身操作自主控制器的有效性仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: Prior CaP systems often rely on high-level, human-designed primitives, making it difficult to separate agent capability from designer-provided scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 先前的 CaP 系统往往依赖高层、人工设计的原语，使得难以将代理能力与设计者提供的脚手架分离。

sentences.en: We present CaP-X, an open-access framework for systematically studying Code-as-Policy agents in robot manipulation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 CaP-X——一个用于系统研究机器人操作中代码即策略代理的开放获取框架。

sentences.en: CaP-X includes four components.
sentences.zh: CaP-X 包含四个组成部分。

sentences.en: CaP-Gym is an interactive environment in which coding agents control robots by synthesizing and executing programs that compose perception and control primitives.
sentences.zh: CaP-Gym 是一个交互式环境，其中编码代理通过合成和执行组合了感知与控制原语的程序来控制机器人。

sentences.en: Building on this foundation, CaP-Bench evaluates frontier language and vision-language models across varying levels of abstraction, interaction, and perceptual grounding.
sentences.zh: 在这一基础之上，CaP-Bench 在不同层级的抽象、交互与感知根基下评估前沿语言与视觉-语言模型。

sentences.en: Across 12 models, the task success rates improve with human-crafted abstractions but degrade as these priors are removed, exposing a dependence on designer scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 在 12 个模型上，任务成功率随人工设计的抽象而提升，但随着这些先验被移除而下降，暴露出对设计者脚手架的依赖。

sentences.en: At the same time, we observe that scaling test-time computation with multi-turn interaction, structured execution feedback, visual differencing, automatic skill synthesis, and ensembled reasoning can substantially improve robustness even when agents operate over low-level primitives.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们观察到，通过多轮交互、结构化执行反馈、视觉差分、自动技能合成与集成推理来扩展测试时计算，即使代理在低层原语上运行，也能大幅提升鲁棒性。

sentences.en: These findings motivate CaP-Agent0, a training-free framework that achieves near human-level reliability on several manipulation tasks in simulation and on real embodiments.
sentences.zh: 这些发现催生了 CaP-Agent0——一个免训练框架，在模拟与真实实施例的若干操作任务上达到了接近人类水平的可靠性。

sentences.en: CaP-RL explores reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to improve success rates and supports sim-to-real transfer through a shared code-as-action-space interface.
sentences.zh: CaP-RL 探索使用可验证奖励的强化学习以提升成功率，并通过共享的代码即动作空间接口支持从模拟到真实的迁移。

sentences.en: Together, CaP-X provides an open-access platform for advancing embodied coding agents.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，CaP-X 为推进具身编码代理提供了一个开放获取的平台。

sentences.en: Project page: https://capgym.github.io
sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://capgym.github.io

authors.name: Yuke Zhu
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Austin

title_en: Capability Traps in DPO
title_zh: 直接偏好优化中的能力陷阱

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is often tuned by selecting checkpoints with high preference margins.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）的调参往往通过选择具有高偏好边距的检查点来进行。

sentences.en: We show that this selection rule can fail.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这种选择规则可能失效。

sentences.en: Across dense $\beta$ sweeps in three 7B open-weight families under controlled DPO recipes, the DPO preference margin can strongly anticorrelate with capability probes, with the strongest observed case in Llama logic probes (Pearson $r=-0.91$, $n=13$).
sentences.zh: 在受控 DPO 配方下、三个 7B 开放权重家族的稠密 $\beta$ 扫掠中，DPO 偏好边距可能与能力探针强烈反相关，在 Llama 逻辑探针中观察到最强情形（Pearson $r=-0.91$、$n=13$）。

sentences.en: In Mistral, matched-duration controls show that transient exposure to higher $\beta$ produces persistent arithmetic ($d_z = 3.73$, $p = 0.002$) and format ($d_z = 3.38$, $p = 0.003$) degradation relative to a duration-matched constant-$\beta$ run, while logic and sycophancy show no significant effect.
sentences.zh: 在 Mistral 中，匹配持续时间的对照表明，短暂接触较高的 $\beta$ 会产生相对于持续时间匹配的恒定-$beta$ 运行的持久算术退化（$d_z = 3.73$、$p = 0.002$）与格式退化（$d_z = 3.38$、$p = 0.003$），而逻辑与谄媚则无显著影响。

sentences.en: An expanded 14-probe logic suite further shows that aggregate capability scores can hide stable opposition between probe clusters: direct-inference probes are consistently negative while fallacy-detection probes are consistently positive, with 13 of 14 probes sign-stable across 3 seeds and 3 $\beta$ values.
sentences.zh: 一个扩展的 14 探针逻辑套件进一步表明，聚合能力分数可能掩盖探针簇之间稳定的对立：直接推断探针一致为负，而谬误检测探针一致为正，14 个探针中有 13 个在 3 个种子与 3 个 $\beta$ 值下符号保持稳定。

sentences.en: Sensitivity profiles differ across architectures: Mistral shows elevated seed variance near $\beta \approx 10^{-2}$, Llama shows capability-specific rigidity, and Qwen trades off smoothly.
sentences.zh: 敏感性轮廓因架构而异：Mistral 在 $\beta \approx 10^{-2}$ 附近表现出升高的种子方差，Llama 表现出能力特异的刚性，而 Qwen 则平稳地进行权衡。

sentences.en: These findings motivate probe-resolved $\beta$ sweeps rather than margin-based checkpoint selection.
sentences.zh: 这些发现推动了基于探针分解的 $\beta$ 扫掠，而非基于边距的检查点选择。

title_en: Capacitated Fair-Range Clustering: Hardness and Approximation Algorithms
title_zh: 具有容量约束的公平范围聚类：困难性与近似算法

sentences.en: Capacitated fair-range $k$-clustering generalizes classical $k$-clustering by incorporating both capacity constraints and demographic fairness.
sentences.zh: 带容量约束的公平区间 $k$-聚类通过同时纳入容量约束与人口统计公平性，推广了经典的 $k$-聚类。

sentences.en: In this setting, data points are categorized as clients and facilities; each facility has a capacity and may belong to one or more possibly intersecting demographic groups.
sentences.zh: 在该设定中，数据点被划分为客户端与设施两类；每个设施都有一个容量，且可能属于一个或多个可能相交的人口统计组。

sentences.en: The task is to select $k$ facilities as centers and assign each client to a center so that: ($a$) no center exceeds its capacity, ($b$) the number of centers selected from each group lies within specified lower and upper bounds (fair-range constraints), and ($c$) the clustering cost (e.g., $k$-median or $k$-means) is minimized.
sentences.zh: 任务是从设施中选择 $k$ 个作为中心，并将每个客户端分配给一个中心，使得：（a）任何中心都不超过其容量；（b）从每个组中选出的中心数量位于指定的下界与上界之间（公平区间约束）；（c）聚类成本（如 $k$-中位数或 $k$-均值）被最小化。

sentences.en: In a prior work, Thejaswi et al. (2022) showed that even satisfying fair-range constraints is NP-hard, thereby making the problem inapproximable to any polynomial factor.
sentences.zh: 在先前的工作中，Thejaswi 等人（2022）证明，即使满足公平区间约束也是 NP 难的，从而使该问题无法被近似到任何多项式因子。

sentences.en: Our first main result strengthens this by showing that inapproximability persists even when the fair-range constraints are trivially satisfiable, highlighting the intrinsic computational complexity of the clustering task itself.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个主要结果加强了这一结论，表明即使在公平区间约束平凡可满足的情况下，不可近似性依然存在，凸显了聚类任务本身的内在计算复杂性。

sentences.en: These inapproximability results hold even on tree metrics and when the number of groups is logarithmic in the size of the facility set.
sentences.zh: 这些不可近似性结果即使在树度量上、以及当组数目对设施集规模呈对数时也依然成立。

sentences.en: In light of strong inapproximability results, we focus on a practical setting where the number of groups is constant.
sentences.zh: 鉴于强不可近似性结果，我们专注于组数目为常数的实用设定。

sentences.en: Our second main result is a polynomial-time $O(\log k)$- and $O(\log^2 k)$-approximation algorithm for $k$-median and $k$-means objectives, respectively, in this regime.
sentences.zh: 我们的第二个主要结果是：在该设定下，针对 $k$-中位数与 $k$-均值目标，分别给出了多项式时间的 $O(\log k)$- 与 $O(\log^2 k)$-近似算法。

sentences.en: Next, we design constant factor approximation algorithms for these problems that run in fixed parameterized tractable time in $k$.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们为这些问题设计了常数因子近似算法，它们以关于 $k$ 的固定参数可解时间运行。

sentences.en: All our approximation guarantees match the best bounds for  capacitated clustering without fair-range constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们的所有近似保证都与无公平区间约束的带容量聚类的最佳界相匹配。

sentences.en: Finally, as our third main contribution, we show that our polynomial-time algorithms are, to our knowledge, the first to have provable approximation guarantees that can practically solve problem instances of modest size.
sentences.zh: 最后，作为我们的第三个主要贡献，我们表明这些多项式时间算法（据我们所知）是首批拥有可证明近似保证、且能够实际求解中等规模问题实例的算法。

authors.institution: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

title_en: Capacity without Access: Reinterpreting the Mid-Depth Spectral Plateau in LLMs
title_zh: 有容量却无法访问：重新解读大语言模型中间深度的频谱平台期

sentences.en: Prior probing-based analyses show that individual layers specialize in distinct linguistic and semantic functions, while a complementary line of work observes that deeper layers enter an alignment-dominated regime where residual transformations become increasingly constrained relative to the evolving hidden-state geometry.
sentences.zh: 先前的基于探针的分析表明，各层在各自不同的语言与语义功能上具有专门化作用，而另一条互补的工作线则观察到，更深的层进入一个以对齐为主导的区间，在此区间内，残差变换相对于不断演化的隐状态几何变得日益受限。

sentences.en: These findings appear to conflict: layer-wise functional specialization versus apparent representational stagnation in deeper layers.
sentences.zh: 这些发现似乎相互冲突：逐层的功能专门化对比深层明显的表示停滞。

sentences.en: This raises a key question: Is the observed representational stagnation in deeper layers attributable to suboptimal acquisition or encoding of novel features, or are these features learned appropriately but exhibit minimal marginal contribution to the model’s predictive output?
sentences.zh: 这引出了一个关键问题：深层观察到的表示停滞，究竟应归因于新特征获取或编码的欠优，还是这些特征已被恰当地学习、却对模型的预测输出贡献极微？

sentences.en: We address this by separating model behavior into (i) representational capacity: the richness and spectral diversity of the encoded features, and (ii) accessibility: the extent to which these features are aligned with, and exploited by, the output-relevant subspace.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将模型行为分为（i）表示容量：编码特征的丰富度与频谱多样性，以及（ii）可访问性：这些特征与输出相关子空间对齐并被其利用的程度，来回答这一问题。

sentences.en: Analyzing hidden-state second-moment geometry across depth shows that intermediate layers maintain a broad representational span and rich spectral diversity, yet project only weakly onto the output-relevant subspace, indicating intact representational capacity but constrained accessibility within task-relevant dimensions.
sentences.zh: 跨深度分析隐态二阶矩几何表明，中间层保持着广阔的表示跨度与丰富的频谱多样性，然而它们仅微弱地投影到输出相关子空间上，这表明表示容量完好，但在任务相关维度上的可访问性受限。

sentences.en: To probe their functional relevance, we add a controlled diagnostic pathway that routes intermediate-layer embeddings to the terminal readout.
sentences.zh: 为探测它们的功能相关性，我们添加了一条受控的诊断通路，将中间层嵌入路由到终端读出。

sentences.en: Analysis of the induced behavioral changes indicates that the apparent stagnation is better accounted for by geometric limitations on accessibility, rather than by a deficit in representational capacity.
sentences.zh: 对由此引发的行为变化的分析表明，这种表面上的停滞更多地应归因于可访问性上的几何限制，而非表示容量的不足。

sentences.en: The source code is available here.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在此处获取。

title_en: Capacity-Agnostic Parameter Isolation for Continual Graph Learning
title_zh: 用于持续图学习的容量无关参数隔离

sentences.en: Existing parameter isolation-based continual learning methods employ diverse designs to accommodate more tasks within limited model capacity, but often incur increasing computational overhead as model capacity expands for growing task streams.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于参数隔离的持续学习方法采用多种设计，以在有限的模型容量内容纳更多任务，但随着模型容量为不断增长的任务流而扩展，它们往往会产生不断增加的计算开销。

sentences.en: To address this efficiency bottleneck, we propose CAGNN, a graph continual learning framework with a biological neuron-inspired architecture that features capacity-agnostic efficiency.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一效率瓶颈，我们提出了 CAGNN——一个采用生物神经元启发的架构、具有容量无关效率的图持续学习框架。

sentences.en: CAGNN leverages graph contextual information to construct task-specific subnetworks and decouples them during training and inference, reducing full-network propagation overhead while enabling knowledge transfer across tasks.
sentences.zh: CAGNN 利用图上下文信息构建任务特有的子网络，并在训练与推理期间将其解耦，从而在支持跨任务知识迁移的同时，减少全网络传播的开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate CAGNN's superior effectiveness and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了 CAGNN 相对于最先进方法在有效性与计算效率两方面的优越性。

title_en: Capacity-Aware Mixture Law Enables Efficient LLM Data Optimization
title_zh: 容量感知混合定律实现高效大语言模型数据优化

sentences.en: A data mixture refers to how different data sources are combined to train large language models, and selecting an effective mixture is crucial for optimal downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 数据混合指不同的数据源如何组合起来训练大语言模型，而选择有效的混合方案对于获得最优的下游性能至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing methods either conduct costly searches directly on the target model or rely on mixture scaling laws that fail to extrapolate well to large model sizes.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么直接在目标模型上进行昂贵的搜索，要么依赖难以很好外推到大规模模型的混合标度定律。

sentences.en: We address these limitations by introducing a compute-efficient pipeline for data mixture scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入一条计算高效的、用于数据混合标度的流水线来解决这些局限。

sentences.en: First, we propose CAMEL, a capacity-aware mixture law that models validation loss with the nonlinear interplay between model size and mixture.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们提出了 CAMEL——一条容量感知的混合定律，它通过模型规模与混合之间的非线性相互作用来建模验证损失。

sentences.en: We also introduce a loss-to-benchmark prediction law that estimates benchmark accuracy from validation loss, enabling end-to-end performance prediction for the target model.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入了一条损失到基准的预测定律，它从验证损失估算基准准确率，从而能够对目标模型进行端到端的性能预测。

sentences.en: Next, we study how to allocate a fixed compute budget across model scales to fit the law and reduce prediction error.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们研究如何在各模型规模之间分配固定的计算预算，以拟合该定律并降低预测误差。

sentences.en: Finally, we apply our method to Mixture-of-Experts models with up to 7B-A150M parameters to fit the law, and verify the optimal mixture derived from the law by extrapolating to a 55B-A1.2B target model.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将我们的方法应用于参数多达 7B-A150M 的混合专家（MoE）模型以拟合该定律，并通过外推到一个 55B-A1.2B 的目标模型来验证由该定律推导出的最优混合方案。

sentences.en: Compared to prior methods, we reduce mixture optimization costs by 50\% and improves downstream benchmark performance by up to 3\%.
sentences.zh: 与先前方法相比，我们将混合优化成本降低了 50\%，并将下游基准性能提升了至多 3\%。

title_en: CapBencher: Give Your LLM Benchmark a Built-in Alarm for Test-Set Overfitting
title_zh: CapBencher：为大语言模型基准内置测试集过拟合警报

sentences.en: Publishing a large language model (LLM) benchmark (especially its ground-truth answers) on the Internet risks contaminating future LLMs and enabling evaluation gaming: it may be unintentionally (or intentionally) used to train or select a model, or exploited to overfit and hack leaderboards when labels are accessible.
sentences.zh: 在互联网上发布大语言模型（LLM）基准（尤其是其金标准答案）存在污染未来 LLM 并助长评估作弊的风险：基准可能被无意（或有意）地用于训练或选模，或在标签可获取时被利用来进行过拟合与攻榜。

sentences.en: A common mitigation is to keep the benchmark private and let participants submit their models or predictions to the organizers, but this still permits test-set overfitting through feedback loops.
sentences.zh: 一种常见的缓解措施是将基准保持私有，让参与者向组织者提交模型或预测，但这仍会通过反馈回路允许测试集过拟合。

sentences.en: To overcome this issue, we propose CapBencher, a way to publish benchmarks without fully disclosing the ground-truth answers, while preserving open evaluation of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一问题，我们提出了 CapBencher——一种在发布基准时不完整公开金标准答案、同时保持对 LLM 开放评估的方法。

sentences.en: The main idea is to reduce the best possible accuracy, i.e., Bayes accuracy, by injecting randomness to the answers by preparing several logically correct answers, and only include one of them as the solution in the benchmark.
sentences.zh: 核心思想是通过准备若干个逻辑上正确的答案、并仅将其中的一个作为基准中的解，向答案注入随机性，从而降低最高的可能准确率（即贝叶斯准确率）。

sentences.en: Not only does this obscure the ground-truth answers, but it also offers a test for leakage or gaming: since even fully capable models should not surpass the Bayes accuracy, any model that does is a strong signal.
sentences.zh: 这不仅掩盖了金标准答案，还提供了对泄露或作弊的检验：既然即使是能力完全的模型也不应超过贝叶斯准确率，那么任何超过它的模型都是一个强烈的信号。

sentences.en: We show theoretically and empirically that CapBencher accurately detects test-set overfitting across diverse benchmarks, models, training methodologies, and scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们理论上和经验上地表明，CapBencher 能在多样的基准、模型、训练方法与场景中准确检测测试集过拟合。

authors.name: Ikko Yamane
authors.institution: Ecole Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Analyse de l'information

title_en: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
title_zh: 原生图形界面智能体的验证码求解：自动生成推理–动作数据与自纠正训练

sentences.en: GUI agents are rapidly shifting from multi-module pipelines to end-to-end, native vision-language models (VLMs) that perceive raw screenshots and directly interact with digital devices.
sentences.zh: GUI 代理正迅速从多模块流水线转向端到端的原生视觉-语言模型（VLM），后者感知原始屏幕截图并直接与数字设备交互。

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress on general GUI tasks, CAPTCHA solving remains a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 尽管通用 GUI 任务取得了快速进展，验证码求解仍然是一项重大挑战。

sentences.en: On the other hand, although specialized CAPTCHA solving pipelines exist, they cannot handle general GUI tasks.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，虽然存在专门的验证码求解流水线，但它们无法处理通用 GUI 任务。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce ReCAP: a CAPTCHA-capable native GUI agent that solves modern, interactive CAPTCHA challenges while retaining general GUI-agent performance.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了 ReCAP：一个具备验证码求解能力的原生 GUI 代理，它既能破解现代、交互式的验证码挑战，又保留通用 GUI 代理的性能。

sentences.en: We first develop a dynamic CAPTCHA system spanning seven representative CAPTCHA types, designed to stress primitive and complementary capabilities for CAPTCHA solving.
sentences.zh: 我们首先开发了一个动态验证码系统，涵盖七种具有代表性的验证码类型，旨在考验求解验证码所需的基础与互补能力。

sentences.en: Then, we develop an automated data collection and curation pipeline that generates large-scale CAPTCHA interaction trajectories paired with reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们开发了一条自动化的数据收集与整理流水线，生成大规模的验证码交互轨迹，并配有推理轨迹。

sentences.en: As CAPTCHA solving often requires multi-step interaction and recovery from intermediate mistakes, we further leverage failed trajectories to construct self-correction data, training agents to reflect on errors and correct their actions online.
sentences.zh: 由于验证码求解常常需要多步交互并从中间错误中恢复，我们进一步利用失败轨迹构建自我纠正数据，训练代理反思错误并在线纠正其动作。

sentences.en: Across synthetic and real-world test sets, ReCAP substantially improves CAPTCHA-solving success over its base agents, while maintaining strong performance on general GUI-agent benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界的测试集上，ReCAP 相比其基础代理显著提升了验证码求解成功率，同时保持在通用 GUI 代理基准上的强劲性能。

title_en: Capturing Gaze Shifts for Guidance: Cross-Modal Fusion Enhancement for VLM Hallucination Mitigation
title_zh: 捕捉注视转移以进行引导：增强跨模态融合以缓解视觉语言模型幻觉

sentences.en: Vision language models (VLMs) often generate hallucination, i.e., content that cannot be substantiated by either textual or visual inputs.
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）常常产生幻觉，即无法由文本或视觉输入加以证实的内容。

sentences.en: Prior work primarily attributes this to over-reliance on linguistic prior knowledge rather than visual inputs.
sentences.zh: 先前工作主要将其归因于对文本先验知识（而非视觉输入）的过度依赖。

sentences.en: Some methods attempt to mitigate hallucination by amplifying visual token attention proportionally to their attention scores.
sentences.zh: 一些方法尝试通过与注意力分数成比例地放大视觉 token 注意力来缓解幻觉。

sentences.en: However, these methods overlook the visual attention sink problem, where attention is frequently misallocated to task-irrelevant visual regions, and neglect cross-modal fusion balance by enhancing only visual attention without adjusting attention to the user query.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法忽视了视觉注意力汇（visual attention sink）问题（注意力常常被错配到与任务无关的视觉区域），并且因只增强视觉注意力而不调整对用户查询的注意力，从而忽视了跨模态融合的平衡。

sentences.en: This can result in amplifying incorrect areas while failing to properly interpret the user query.
sentences.zh: 这可能导致放大错误的区域，同时无法恰当地解读用户查询。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a simple yet effective method called Gaze Shift-Guided Cross-modal Fusion Enhancement (GIFT).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种简单而有效的方法，名为注视转移引导的跨模态融合增强（GIFT）。

sentences.en: GIFT pre-computes a holistic visual saliency map by tracking positive changes in visual attention, or "gaze shifts", during user query comprehension, and leverages this map to amplify attention to both salient visual information and the user query at each decoding step.
sentences.zh: GIFT 通过在用户查询理解过程中追踪视觉注意力的正向变化（即“注视转移”）来预先计算一幅整体视觉显著图，并利用该图在每个解码步骤放大对显著视觉信息与用户查询两方面的注意力。

sentences.en: This reduces the impact of visual attention sink, as irrelevant tokens exhibit minimal shifts, while ensuring balanced cross-modal fusion for well-integrated representation.
sentences.zh: 这削弱了视觉注意力汇的影响（因为无关 token 表现出极小的转移），同时通过良好整合的表示确保平衡的跨模态融合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that GIFT effectively mitigates hallucination in VLMs across both generative and classification tasks, achieving up to 20.7% improvement over greedy decoding, while maintaining general vision-language performance with low computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，GIFT 在生成式与分类任务上都能有效缓解 VLM 中的幻觉，与贪心解码相比最多提升 20.7%，同时以较低的计算开销保持通用的视觉-语言性能。

title_en: Caracal: Causal Architecture via Spectral Mixing
title_zh: Caracal：通过谱混合构建因果架构

sentences.en: The scalability of Large Language Models to long sequences is hindered by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the limitations of positional encodings.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型向长序列的可扩展性受限于自注意力的二次方成本以及位置编码的局限。

sentences.en: To address these, we introduce **Caracal**, a novel architecture that replaces self-attention with a parameter-efficient, $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ Multi-Head Fourier (MHF) module.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们引入了 **Caracal**——一种新颖的架构，它用参数高效的、$\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ 多头傅里叶（MHF）模块取代了自注意力。

sentences.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) We leverage the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for sequence mixing, inherently addressing both bottlenecks mentioned above.
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：（1）我们利用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）进行序列混合，从本质上同时解决了上述两个瓶颈。

sentences.en: (2) We apply a frequency-domain causal masking technique that enforces autoregressive capabilities via asymmetric padding and truncation, overcoming a critical barrier for Fourier-based generative models.
sentences.zh: （2）我们采用了一种频域因果掩码技术，通过非对称填充与截断来强制实现自回归能力，克服了基于傅里叶的生成模型的一个关键障碍。

sentences.en: (3) Unlike efficient models relying on hardware-specific implementations (e.g., Mamba), **Caracal** uses standard library operators.
sentences.zh: （3）与依赖硬件专用实现的高效模型（如 Mamba）不同，**Caracal** 使用标准的库算子。

sentences.en: This ensures robust portability, eliminating common deployment barriers.
sentences.zh: 这确保了稳健的可移植性，消除了常见的部署障碍。

sentences.en: Evaluations demonstrate that **Caracal** performs competitively with Transformer and SSM baselines, offering a scalable and simple pathway for efficient long-sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，**Caracal** 与 Transformer 和 SSM 基线的性能相当，为高效的长序列建模提供了一条可扩展而简单的路径。

sentences.en: Code is available in the supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 代码可在补充材料中获取。

title_en: CARD: Coarse-to-fine Autoregressive Modeling with Radix-based Decomposition for Transferable Free Energy Estimation
title_zh: CARD：采用基数分解的由粗到细自回归建模，实现可迁移的自由能估计

sentences.en: Estimating free energy differences quantifies thermodynamic preferences in molecular interactions, which is central to chemistry and drug discovery.
sentences.zh: 估计自由能差异能够量化分子相互作用中的热力学偏好，这在化学与药物发现领域处于核心地位。

sentences.en: Despite fruitful progress, existing methods still face key limitations: classical computational approaches remain prohibitively expensive due to their reliance on extensive molecular dynamics simulations, while deep learning-based methods are constrained by either less-expressive generative models or input dimensions tied to a specific system, resulting in negligible generalization.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了丰硕进展，现有方法仍面临关键局限：经典计算方法因依赖大规模分子动力学模拟而昂贵到难以承受，而基于深度学习的方法要么受限于表达力较弱的生成模型，要么受限于与特定系统绑定的输入维度，导致泛化能力近乎为零。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose CARD, a generative framework that employs a novel radix-based decomposition to bijectively convert 3D coordinates into mixed discrete-continuous sequences, enabling coarse-to-fine autoregressive modeling with enhanced expressiveness.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CARD——一个生成框架，采用新颖的基数分解将 3D 坐标双射地转换为混合的离散-连续序列，从而支持表达力增强的由粗到细自回归建模。

sentences.en: Notably, the model corresponds to a distribution with zero free energy, serving as a proposal for absolute free energy computation of arbitrary systems without relying on alchemical pathways.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，该模型对应一个自由能为零的分布，可作为任意系统绝对自由能计算的提案分布，而无需依赖炼金术（alchemical）路径。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate that CARD matches the accuracy of classical computational methods on unseen systems with diverse topologies, while achieving an approximately 40-fold speedup in inference.
sentences.zh: 跨多样化任务的实验表明，CARD 在具有多样拓扑结构的未见系统上达到了与经典计算方法相当的准确率，同时实现了约 40 倍的推理加速。

title_en: Cardio-mmFlow: A Gaussian-Prior-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching Framework for Electrocardiogram to mmWave Radar Synthesis
title_zh: Cardio-mmFlow：无需高斯先验的物理信息流匹配框架，用于从心电图合成毫米波雷达信号

sentences.en: Continuous ECG monitoring is clinically valuable, but scaling it beyond electrodes to comfortable long-term use motivates contactless mmWave sensing.
sentences.zh: 连续的心电（ECG）监测在临床上很有价值，但要将其从电极扩展到舒适的长期使用场景，则激发了非接触式毫米波感知的需求。

sentences.en: In practice, mmWave-to-ECG reconstruction is severely constrained by the scarcity of high-quality synchronized recordings.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，毫米波到 ECG 的重建受到高质量同步记录稀缺性的严重制约。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose \textbf{Cardio-mmFlow}, a Gaussian-prior-free physics-informed flow matching framework that synthesizes mmWave radar signals from clinical ECG.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 \textbf{Cardio-mmFlow}——一个无高斯先验的物理信息流匹配框架，用于从临床 ECG 合成毫米波雷达信号。

sentences.en: It learns a direct transport trajectory between the latent manifolds of ECG and radar.
sentences.zh: 它学习 ECG 与雷达潜在流形之间的直接传输轨迹。

sentences.en: Considering subject-dependent propagation differences, we incorporate a simplified mass--spring--damper inspired modulation and inject it into the flow dynamics via feature-wise linear modulation for personalization.
sentences.zh: 考虑到与受试者相关的传播差异，我们纳入了一个简化的质量-弹簧-阻尼器（mass--spring--damper）启发调制，并通过特征级线性调制将其注入流动力学，以实现个性化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that our system generates high fidelity radar data in both signal and latent domains.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的系统在信号域与潜在域都能生成保真度很高的雷达数据。

sentences.en: It significantly improves zero-shot downstream mmWave to ECG task, and enable Atrial Fibrillation classification with synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 它显著提升了毫米波到 ECG 的零样本下游任务，并支持仅用合成数据进行心房颤动（Atrial Fibrillation）分类。

sentences.en: Further analyses evaluate the model interpretability.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析评估了模型的可解释性。

title_en: CARE: Adaptive Calibration for Reliable Recommendations
title_zh: CARE：用于可靠推荐的自适应校准

sentences.en: Modern recommender systems are typically trained offline and deployed with parameters held fixed between periodic refreshes, yet user behavior can evolve substantially during deployment.
sentences.zh: 现代推荐系统通常离线训练，并在两次定期刷新之间以固定参数部署，然而在部署期间用户行为可能发生显著演变。

sentences.en: This can cause ranking utility to degrade over time and makes it difficult to provide formal guarantees about recommendation quality.
sentences.zh: 这会导致排序效用随时间而退化，并使其难以对推荐质量提供形式化保证。

sentences.en: We propose **CARE**, an adaptive calibration framework that wraps an arbitrary backbone recommender and outputs variable-size recommendation sets with finite-sample performance guarantees over interaction streams.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **CARE**——一个自适应校准框架，它包裹任意骨干推荐器，并在交互流上输出具有有限样本性能保证的变长推荐集合。

sentences.en: CARE combines (i) a loss-based monitoring module that localizes behavioral changes and triggers threshold recalibration, and (ii) an online aggregation rule that promotes compact recommendation sets by dynamically reweighting candidate set predictors.
sentences.zh: CARE 结合了（i）一个基于损失的监控模块，用于定位行为变化并触发阈值重新校准，以及（ii）一个在线聚合规则，通过动态重新加权候选集预测器来促进紧凑的推荐集合。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical results establishing finite-sample guarantees for utility-based risk control and bounds on the expected set size relative to the best constituent predictor.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论结果，建立基于效用的风险控制的有限样本保证，以及相对于最优组成预测器的期望集合大小的界。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple datasets and backbone models demonstrate that CARE improves robustness and maintains compact recommendation sets while preserving the desired statistical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集与骨干模型上的实验表明，CARE 在保持所需统计保证的同时，提升了鲁棒性并维持紧凑的推荐集合。

sentences.en: The code and implementation are available in https://github.com/kalpiree/CARE.
sentences.zh: 代码与实现可在 https://github.com/kalpiree/CARE 获取。
